```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

}

                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":

                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

        }
        Files.write(out, sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    } catch (IOException e) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Failed to write output", e);
    }
}

    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

}

private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}
```

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

    }

        if (out.getParent() != null) {
            Files.createDirectories(out.getParent());
        }
        Files.write(out, sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    } catch (IOException e) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Failed to write output", e);
    }
}

private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}
```

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}

```java
private void parseScript(String content) {
    String[] lines = content.split("\n");
    boolean dtSet = false, ticksSet = false;
    Set<String> declaredActors = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    Set<String> movedActors = new HashSet<>();
    Pattern idPattern = Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z0-9_]+");
    
    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.length; lineNum++) {
        String line = lines[lineNum].trim();
        if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
        
        String[] tokens = line.split("\\s+");
        String directive = tokens[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        
        switch (directive) {
            case "dt":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'dt'");
                dt = Float.parseFloat(tokens[1]);
                if (dt <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dt must be > 0");
                dtSet = true;
                break;
            case "ticks":
                if (tokens.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate 'ticks'");
                ticks = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
                if (ticks < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ticks must be >= 0");
                ticksSet = true;
                break;
            case "actor":
                if (tokens.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("actor before dt/ticks");
                String id = tokens[1];
                if (!idPattern.matcher(id).matches()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid actor id");
                if (!declaredActors.add(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate actor id");
                float x = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float y = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                Actor actor = new Actor();
                actor.setPosition(x, y);
                actor.setName(id);
                actors.put(id, actor);
                order.add(id);
                break;
            case "moveby":
                if (tokens.length != 5) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...);
                if (!dtSet || !ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby before dt/ticks");
                String mid = tokens[1];
                if (!declaredActors.contains(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("moveby for unknown actor: " + mid);
                if (!movedActors.add(mid)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate moveby for actor: " + mid);
                float dx = Float.parseFloat(tokens[2]);
                float dy = Float.parseFloat(tokens[3]);
                float dur = Float.parseFloat(tokens[4]);
                if (dur < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duration must be >= 0");
                MoveByAction action = new MoveByAction();
                action.setAmount(dx, dy);
                action.setDuration(dur);
                actors.get(mid).addAction(action);
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown directive: " + directive);
        }
    }
    
    if (!dtSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing dt directive");
    if (!ticksSet) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing ticks directive");
}
```
